scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api fastapi dev app/main.py --host 127.0.0.1 --port 7332
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @reqlens/web && uv run --directory apps/api mypy app
